mapper.sql: pis_id AS id, pis_instance_id AS instanceId, pis_stage_id AS stageId, pis_node_type AS nodeType, pis_round AS round, pis_status AS status, pis_result AS result, pis_ref_id AS refId, pis_node_name AS nodeName, pis_operator_id AS operatorId, pis_start_at AS startAt, pis_end_at AS endAt, pis_result_note AS resultNote, pis_created_at AS createdAt
mapper.select: select pin_id from t_process_instance where pin_id = #{instanceId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into t_process_instance_stage (pis_instance_id, pis_stage_id, pis_node_type, pis_round, pis_status, pis_result, pis_ref_id, pis_node_name, pis_operator_id, pis_start_at, pis_end_at, pis_result_note) values (#{instanceId}, #{stageId}, #{nodeType}, #{round}, #{status}, #{result}, #{refId}, #{nodeName}, #{operatorId}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{resultNote})
mapper.update: update t_process_instance_stage set pis_result = #{result}, pis_result_note = #{resultNote}, pis_status = 2, pis_end_at = now() where pis_id = #{id} and pis_status in (0, 1)
mapper.select: select from t_process_instance_stage where pis_instance_id = #{instanceId} order by pis_id
select from t_process_instance_stage where pis_instance_id = #{instanceId} order by case when pis_status in (0, 1) then 0 else 1 end, pis_id desc limit 1
